mechanism_narrative: A lower federal funds rate (FEDFUNDS) compresses discount rates applied to equity cash flows, producing positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days. This relationship is consistently observed in historical data during periods of monetary accommodation.
failure_condition: SPX 20-day returns are negative in more than 55% of periods when FEDFUNDS is below 0.5% (over the last 10 years).

mechanism_narrative: When the unemployment rate (UNRATE) exceeds 7.5%, it signals a deteriorating labor market that typically precedes reduced consumer spending and corporate earnings growth, resulting in negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX 20-day returns are positive in more than 55% of instances when UNRATE > 7.5% (over the last 10 years).

mechanism_narrative: A concurrent expansion in housing starts (HOUST) and retail sales (RSAFS) above their respective 3-month moving averages indicates robust consumer demand, which drives positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days through strengthened corporate revenue expectations.
failure_condition: SPX 20-day returns are negative in more than 55% of periods when both HOUST and RSAFS are above their 3-month moving averages (over the last 10 years).

mechanism_narrative: During a monetary tightening cycle (FEDFUNDS > 2.5%), the Federal Reserve's policy rate hikes increase borrowing costs and reduce corporate investment, leading to negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX 20-day returns are positive in more than 55% of periods when FEDFUNDS > 2.5% (over the last 10 years).

mechanism_narrative: A sustained increase in non-farm payrolls (PAYEMS) indicates a strengthening labor market that supports consumer spending and corporate earnings growth, resulting in positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX 20-day returns are negative in more than 55% of periods when PAYEMS growth is positive (over the last 10 years).

mechanism_narrative: A decline in industrial production (INDPRO) below 95 signals a contraction in manufacturing and services output, which typically leads to reduced corporate profits and negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 60 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX 60-day returns are positive in more than 55% of instances when INDPRO < 95 (over the last 10 years).

mechanism_narrative: A combination of strong quarterly GDP growth (GDPC1 > 2.0%) and rising housing starts (HOUST > 900) signals a robust economic expansion that drives positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 5 trading days through immediate corporate revenue momentum.
failure_condition: SPX 5-day returns are negative in more than 55% of periods when both GDPC1 > 2.0% and HOUST > 900 (over the last 10 years).

mechanism_narrative: When inflation (CPIAUCSL) is below 2.0%, it signals a low-inflation environment that typically leads the Federal Reserve to maintain accommodative monetary policy, resulting in positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX 20-day returns are negative in more than 55% of periods when CPIAUCSL < 2.0% (over the last 10 years).
